AuxChannelMap.description:
Roles of the auxiliary (NIDQ) channels.

``analog`` maps a role to the analog input index (XA<n> / AI<n>); ``digital`` maps a role
to a line of the digital word (:class:`DigitalLineConfig`). Defaults reproduce the MATLAB pipeline
(``multiParadigmArtefactRemovalAndSpikesortingComb_contEye_CR.m``) for 8-channel rigs.

digital.description: Role -> digital line: { bit, active, description, in_events } or the bit alone
digital.title: Digital

AuxChannelMap.title: AuxChannelMap

CalibrationConfig.description:
Channel gains from a recording of a calibration sine on all inputs (``ephysalis calibrate``),
by the input format's channel gain calibration (:class:`~ephysalis.plugins.ComputesChannelGainCalibration`), e.g. the DAQ format of ephysalis-bremen. Without ``run`` and ``file`` the gains of the
recording are used.

run.description: Calibration run of this session, e.g. 15hz_after_2005_03_30
run.title: Run

file.description: calibration.json of another session's work dir (relative to session.toml), for sessions without their own calibration recording
file.title: File

amplitude_uv.description: Amplitude of the calibration sine at the electrodes (µV)
amplitude_uv.title: Amplitude Uv

frequency_range_hz.description: Search range of the sine frequency (the lab's generator ran at about 15.4 Hz)
frequency_range_hz.title: Frequency Range Hz

min_relative_amplitude.description: Channels whose sine is below this fraction of the median amplitude of the probe have no calibration signal
min_relative_amplitude.title: Min Relative Amplitude

missing.description: Gain of channels without calibration signal: 'nan' (left out of the CSD) or 'median' (median gain of the probe)
missing.title: Missing

CalibrationConfig.title: CalibrationConfig

ChannelQualityConfig.description:
Channel selection on the LFP of each run (``ephysalis quality``, :mod:`ephysalis.processing.quality`; port of the
Fritz/Mini BIDS conversions). The CSD then uses the good channels only. Defaults: their criteria.

neighbour_radius_um.description: Neighbours of a channel: contacts within this distance (Fritz epidural array 3100, intracortical arrays 2100)
neighbour_radius_um.title: Neighbour Radius Um

max_clip_fraction.description: Bad if clipping in this fraction of the windows
max_clip_fraction.title: Max Clip Fraction

max_abs_power_z.description: Bad if the robust z of the 2-200 Hz power is beyond
max_abs_power_z.title: Max Abs Power Z

min_neighbour_correlation.description: Bad if the 2-100 Hz correlation with the mean of the neighbours is below
min_neighbour_correlation.title: Min Neighbour Correlation

max_line_db.description: Bad if the 50 Hz peak is this far above 40-60 Hz (dB)
max_line_db.title: Max Line Db

ChannelQualityConfig.title: ChannelQualityConfig

CsdConfig.description:
Current source density of a 2-D electrode array (Borisov's ``dh_csd`` V3.1 [RBF], :mod:`ephysalis.processing.csd`):
Gaussian RBF interpolation of the LFP through the input electrodes, CSD = -Laplacian /
specific resistance at the output electrodes. Defaults: the lab's parameters for the Fritz array.

grid_spacing_m.description: Array grid spacing (m); the RBF width is grid_spacing_m x rbf_parameter
grid_spacing_m.title: Grid Spacing M

specific_resistance_ohm_m.description: Specific resistance of the tissue (Ohm m)
specific_resistance_ohm_m.title: Specific Resistance Ohm M

exclude_inputs.description: Channel ids not used as inputs (e.g. a bad electrode); channels without calibration are left out as well. Outputs: all channels of the probe
exclude_inputs.title: Exclude Inputs

CsdConfig.title: CsdConfig

DigitalLineConfig.description:
A digital (TTL) line with a role: ``role = { bit = 0, active = "high", description = "..." }`` in
``[aux_channels.digital]``, or ``role = 0`` for the bit alone (:mod:`ephysalis.timeline.annotations`).

bit.description: Bit of the digital word (0-based); the TTL line is bit + 1
bit.title: Bit

active.description: Level of the line during a pulse, e.g. 'low' for a lever line that is low while pressed
active.title: Active

description.description: Meaning of the pulses (DH5 /Intervals and TriggerLines, NWB trigger_lines, BIDS events.json); default: the role
description.title: Description

in_events.description: Its edges are in the events; false for fast pulse trains (frame, sync, wheel lines), which are then only documented
in_events.title: In Events

DigitalLineConfig.title: DigitalLineConfig

EventsConfig.description:
Events of the runs (``events/<run>.csv``, DH5 ``EV02``, NWB ``events`` table) and the pulses
and markers made from them (DH5 ``/Intervals``, ``/Markers``; :mod:`ephysalis.timeline.annotations`).

event_word_offset.description: Added to the event words (e.g. VStim's) for their DH5 event codes (TTL lines are +line / -line); used only by the DH5 export
event_word_offset.title: Event Word Offset

lines_without_role.description: Also TTL lines without a role in [aux_channels.digital]; switch off for unconnected digital inputs that toggle (e.g. the USB-ME of MC_Rack recordings)
lines_without_role.title: Lines Without Role

EventsConfig.title: EventsConfig

LineNoiseConfig.description:
Mains removal in the LFP (``ephysalis lfp``) with the recorded mains reference: port of the lab's
``dh_remove_50hz`` (M. Borisov 2004, :mod:`ephysalis.processing.linenoise`). Needs a 1 kHz LFP.

reference_role.description: Analog role ([aux_channels.analog]) of the recorded mains
reference_role.title: Reference Role

min_cycle_fraction.description: The reference of a run is used only if this fraction of its cycles lasts 19-21 ms ...
min_cycle_fraction.title: Min Cycle Fraction

min_peak_db.description: ... and its 50 Hz peak is this far above the spectrum 5-20 Hz away (else the run is left unchanged)
min_peak_db.title: Min Peak Db

subtract_reference_mean.description: Find the zero crossings of the reference after subtracting its mean (as the Fritz/Mini BIDS conversions) instead of on the reference as recorded (dh_remove_50hz)
subtract_reference_mean.title: Subtract Reference Mean

LineNoiseConfig.title: LineNoiseConfig

MarkerConfig.description: A time marker from the pulses of a trigger line or from the trials (:mod:`ephysalis.timeline.annotations`).

role.description: Role of the line ([aux_channels.digital]), or 'trial' for the trials
role.title: Role

edge.description: Start or end of the pulses (trials)
edge.title: Edge

offset_ms.description: Added to the time; a marker with an offset is derived, not measured
offset_ms.title: Offset Ms

MarkerConfig.title: MarkerConfig

stream.description: Input stream of a probe the reader does not detect (non-Neuropixels), e.g. 'Acquisition_Board-100.Rhythm Data'
stream.title: Stream

channels.description: Channel ids of the probe in `stream` (default: all)
channels.title: Channels

reference_channels.description: Re-reference: channel ids of `stream` whose mean is subtracted from the probe's channels before every step (LFP, MUA, CSD, sorting), e.g. a local reference electrode
reference_channels.title: Reference Channels

insertion_depth_um.description: Depth of the probe tip below the brain surface
insertion_depth_um.title: Insertion Depth Um

spike_sorting.description: Sorter for this probe, instead of the session's [spike_sorting]

csd.description: Compute the CSD of this probe (ephysalis csd); needs the probe geometry

quality.description: Select the good channels of this probe (ephysalis quality); needs the probe geometry

ProbeGeometry.description: Probe geometry from the probeinterface library or a probeinterface JSON file.

wiring.description: probeinterface wiring to the headstage, e.g. ASSY-156>RHD2164
wiring.title: Wiring

ProbeGeometry.title: ProbeGeometry

RunConfig.description: A run (recording) of the session; runs not listed are included with the defaults.

name.description: Name of the run as the input format lists it (ephysalis inspect)
name.title: Name

metadata_plugin.description: Metadata plugin; auto-detected if not set
metadata_plugin.title: Metadata Plugin

task.description: Task of the run (BIDS task entity), instead of the session's
task.title: Task

RunConfig.title: RunConfig

SpikeSortingConfig.description: Spike sorter and its parameters (any sorter of ``spikeinterface.sorters``).

sorter.description: spikeinterface sorter name, e.g. kilosort4, mountainsort5, spykingcircus2
sorter.title: Sorter

params.description: Sorter parameters that differ from the sorter's (and ephysalis's) defaults
params.title: Params

SpikeSortingConfig.title: SpikeSortingConfig

SubjectConfig.description: Subject metadata for the NWB file (NWB ``Subject``; DANDI requires species and sex).
SubjectConfig.title: SubjectConfig

schema_version.description: Version of this format; only the current one is read
schema_version.title: Schema Version

session_id.description: Id of the recording session (NWB session_id; in a conversion batch: from its folder)
session_id.title: Session Id

subject_id.description: Id of the subject (NWB / BIDS subject)
subject_id.title: Subject Id

input_format.description: Input format plugin, e.g. spikeglx, openephys, mcd, daq; detected from the files if not set (required in a conversion batch)
input_format.title: Input Format

metadata_plugin.description: Metadata plugin of the runs that do not name their own, e.g. vstim; 'none': no plugin; detected per run if not set (required in a conversion batch)
metadata_plugin.title: Metadata Plugin

task.description: Task (BIDS task entity, e.g. shapetracking); runs can have their own
task.title: Task

runs.description: Runs with settings of their own
runs.title: Runs
